intent.proves: The share of active traded products in the default language and in scope (simple products and variants; a master with variant groups is exempt) that carry a GTIN in ProductEAN reaches the minimum, in percent.
intent.scope: Active products in the default language that are traded: simple products and variant rows; a master that has variant groups is exempt, as in pim.identifiers.number-missing. productScope exclusions apply.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT ISNULL(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.ProductEAN, N'') <> N'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND p.ProductActive = 1{inScope} AND (ISNULL(p.ProductVariantId, N'') <> N'' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomVariantGroupProductRelation v WHERE v.VariantGroupProductRelationProductId = p.ProductId))
